methods.name: TreeSHAP (tree path-dependent Shapley values) and SHAP interaction values for tree ensembles
methods.reference: Exact Shapley values and Shapley interaction index of the path-dependent game E[f(x) | x_S] (Lundberg, Erion & Lee 2020, Algorithm 1 and eqs. 8-9), enumerated over all coalitions and written out in R (no SHAP package is a case dependency); tree from rpart::rpart 4.1.23
quantities: SHAP values (80 training rows, 5 points outside the data)
interaction values (10 rows), symmetry, row sums
methods.tolerance: exact algorithm vs enumeration: 1e-10 relative, 1e-12 absolute (observed <= 1.5e-15); predictions exact; additivity 1e-8 relative to max(1, |f|)

methods.name: Kernel SHAP (interventional): every coalition when 2^M - 2 <= n_samples (M <= 11 at the default budget), shap.KernelExplainer's design otherwise
methods.reference: Exact interventional Shapley values v(S) = mean_b f(x_S, b_notS) (Lundberg & Lee 2017; Janzing, Minorics & Bloebaum 2020) enumerated over all coalitions, written out in R for four fixed models; shap.KernelExplainer's coalition design and constrained solve
quantities: base value E f over the background
efficiency (sum of SHAP values = f(x) - E f)
design: rows, complete sizes, fixed weight
methods.tolerance: exact paths 1e-10 relative, 1e-12 absolute (observed <= 1.5e-14); sampled M = 12 at the default n_samples: 0.15 absolute (twice the maximum of 100 R replications of the design, 0.0729); efficiency 1e-10

deviations.note: p2a draws from ChaCha8 (seed, row stream), not numpy, so the sampled coalitions differ from shap's; only the design and the Monte Carlo accuracy are pinned
